Frontend structure findings:

**API/type definitions**
- `/project/frontend/src/api/types.ts`
  - Auto-generated by `openapi-typescript`.
  - Exports `paths`, `components`, `operations`.
  - Key schemas: `DatasourceProjectGroup`, `GroupedProjectsResponse`, `ProjectsResponse`, `PersonContributionsResponse`, `WorkItem`, `WorkItemsResponse`, `CommitItem`, `CommitsResponse`.
  - API supports grouped projects via `/api/projects/?format=...` returning `GroupedProjectsResponse | ProjectsResponse`.
- `/project/frontend/src/api/client.ts`
  - Lightweight fetch wrapper around `/api`.
  - Defines manual `WorkItemsParams` and `CommitsParams`.
  - Functions include `getProjects`, `getPersons`, `getPersonContributions`, `getWorkItems`, `getCommits`, metric fetchers.
- `/project/frontend/src/hooks/useMetrics.ts`
  - React Query hooks wrapping API client calls.

**Datasource/project filter UI**
- `/project/frontend/src/components/DatasourceProjectFilter.tsx`
  - Main current filter component.
  - Reads/writes URL params: `datasource`, `project`; also supports legacy `projects`.
  - Displays grouped datasources with expandable project lists.
  - Infers datasource from legacy project if needed.
- `/project/frontend/src/components/ProjectFilter.tsx`
  - Older/simple project-only select using legacy `projects` param.
  - Not used by shell.
- `/project/frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx`
  - Places `DatasourceProjectFilter` in global header alongside `TimeframeSelector`.
- `/project/frontend/src/pages/ProjectsPage.tsx`
  - Consumes `datasource`, `project`, legacy `projects`.
  - Sends `projects: [effectiveProject]` plus `datasource` to metric APIs.
- `/project/frontend/src/pages/PeoplePage.tsx`
  - Same datasource/project query pattern for people list and person detail links.

**Person drill-down components**
- `/project/frontend/src/router.tsx`
  - Person route: `/persons/:personId`.
- `/project/frontend/src/pages/PeoplePage.tsx`
  - People table rows navigate to `/persons/{id}?section=work-items...`.
- `/project/frontend/src/pages/PersonDetailPage.tsx`
  - Main drill-down page.
  - Loads person contributions, summary cards, time-series charts, identities.
  - Uses GitHub identity to filter time-series by `actors`.
  - Renders `WorkItemsSection`.
- `/project/frontend/src/components/WorkItemsSection.tsx`
  - Completed work-items area with grouped/timeline toggle.
  - Also renders active work.
- `/project/frontend/src/components/ActiveWorkSection.tsx`
  - Active work items for person.
- `/project/frontend/src/components/GroupedWorkItemsView.tsx`
  - Groups Jira issues, PRs, reviews, GitHub issues, commits.
- `/project/frontend/src/components/TimelineWorkItemsView.tsx`
  - Chronological work-item view.
- `/project/frontend/src/components/WorkItemCard.tsx`
  - Shared display card with datasource/status badges and external links.
- `/project/frontend/src/components/CommitList.tsx`
  - Expandable commit drill-down list.

**Build/typecheck commands**
- `/project/frontend/package.json`
  - `npm run build` = `tsc -b && vite build` — includes typecheck.
  - `npm run lint` = `eslint .`
  - `npm run test` = `vitest run`
  - `npm run dev` = `vite`
  - `npm run typegen` = `openapi-typescript /tmp/openapi.json -o src/api/types.ts`

  - Root only has dependency metadata; frontend commands live under `/project/frontend`.
